title: Model-release smoke battery
description: Structure only. Format identifiers and cardinalities are declared in docs/standards/MODEL_RELEASE_SMOKE_RUNNER_CONTRACT.md, Battery format; they are not performance thresholds.

schema_version.description: Declared format identifier; see the contract's Battery format section.

interface.description: Declared adapter interface identifier, not an executable command.

cases.description: The contract requires a nonempty battery and rejects duplicate case objects. Unique case identities also require a future semantic check.

identity.description: Lowercase ASCII words or digits separated by single hyphens, starting with a letter. The final assertion rejects trailing newlines as well as other trailing characters.

relative_path.description: Literal slash-separated relative path. Segments start and end with ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens; internal dots are allowed. No decoding or expansion is permitted. Runtime containment remains mandatory under Path boundary in the contract.
